richiami.difetto: The driver airbag inflator may malfunction due to long-term degradation. In this case, if the airbag is deployed in an accident, the internal pressure in the inflator may be too high and the inflator could burst, ejecting metal fragments that could cause injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.modello: BMW Alpina B3, BMW Alpina D3
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The driver airbag inflator may malfunction due to long-term degradation.

traduzione.difetto: L'inflatore dell'airbag del conducente potrebbe presentare malfunzionamenti a causa della degradazione a lungo termine. In tal caso, se l'airbag viene attivato in un incidente, la pressione interna nell'inflatore potrebbe essere eccessiva e l'inflatore potrebbe esplodere, espellendo frammenti metallici che potrebbero causare lesioni. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla approvazione e sul controllo del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles an unexpected loss of hydraulic brake assistance may occur and may result in a different pedal behaviour under specific conditions an extended braking distance may be experienced and ABS/Stability control may be impaired
richiami.rimedio: On the affected vehicles the Integrated Brake System will be replaced
richiami.titolo: Integrated Braking System

richiami.difetto: The engine position sensor signal contact of the braking system can be impaired, leading to an unexpected failure of the hydraulic braking assistance. This requires greater pressure on the pedal and results in a longer braking distance, and in a failure of the Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) and Dynamic Stability Control (DSC) systems. This increases the risk of accidents and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

richiami.difetto: The propellant used in the driver airbag inflator may degrade over time. In the event of the affected airbag being deployed, the excessive internal pressure may cause the inflator body to rupture and metal fragments may pass through the cushion material causing injury to the occupants. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.modello: BMW ALPINA D3 Limousine, BMW ALPINA D3 Touring

richiami.difetto: A contact defect can develop over time due to friction corrosion on the plug connection between the cable harness and the fan controller. The insulation of the cable harness can therefore become damaged over time, which could trigger a short circuit. This could result in a vehicle fire, even if the car is parked.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: A contact defect can develop over time due to friction corrosion on the plug connection between the cable harness and the fan controller.

richiami.difetto: The vehicles affected may have been fitted with Takata non-azide driver inflator (NADI) gas generators in which inadequate sealing on the gas generator could allow the ingress of moisture and thus result in the degradation of the propellant. If the airbag deploys, this could cause the gas generator to underinflate or to burst. In the case of under inflation the protective effect is not given. In case of overpressure deployment metal parts can enter the vehicle interior, this could cause serious or fatal injuries to occupants of the vehicle.
